current.text: He projects as the Clippers' sixth man, behind a projected starting backcourt of Darius Garland and Max Strus. He could also start.
Coach Ty Lue is reported to love him.
He is useful for fantasy only if he starts and plays about 28 minutes.
His role is hard to predict. The expert expects a trial season with long rotations and many players tested, and Ty Lue often changes his rotation choices.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21. They have 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.

durable.text: He is a stable, elite defender and a high-steals player who adds a few assists.
He scores little and plays a low-usage role: 13% usage last season.

note: Both Yahoo (rank 189) and ESPN (rank 187) value him at 0 USD, and he went undrafted in our league last season. Only 144 players get drafted, so he is not an auction target. His fantasy value is about 1.4 to 1.5 steals with few turnovers. His 6 points per game hurt, so he works best as a streamer or a steals filler. Early in the season, check whether he starts and gets about 28 minutes. If he does, the 4-3-4 playoff schedule makes him a reasonable waiver add.
